lines.text: You have grown. I did not say you could.
The yard hears the hum. Every stone. You came for a reason or by accident.
Good. Both is the only honest answer.

choice.text: Teach me again. I think I understood too late.
I came to build something that will be remembered.

lines.text: ...Then carry this end. No. The other end.
Then you did not understand at all. Go and look at the Span.
